item.title: 15 years ago today: PJ Harvey released <i>Let England Shake</i>
item.description: On this day 15 years ago, PJ Harvey released her lauded eighth album, <i>Let England Shake,</i> via Island Records. As well as being named Hot Press's Album of the Year for 2011, the project went on to win the prestigious Mercury Prize, and the Album Award at the Ivor Novellos.
